game.title: Diablo II: Resurrected
game.blurb: Remaster of the 2000 action RPG Diablo II with its Lord of Destruction expansion, from Vicarious Visions, released 2021-09-23. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapter order follows the StrategyWiki walkthrough (CC BY-SA 4.0), one chapter per act.

chapters.title: Act I: The Den of Evil to Sisters to the Slaughter
chapters.summary: The six quests of the first act, from clearing the Den of Evil to its final boss quest.

chapters.title: Act II: Radament's Lair to The Seven Tombs
chapters.summary: The six desert quests, from Radament's Lair through the Horadric Staff to the Seven Tombs.

chapters.title: Act III: The Golden Bird to The Guardian
chapters.summary: The six jungle quests, from The Golden Bird to The Guardian.

chapters.title: Act IV: The Fallen Angel to Terror's End
chapters.summary: The three short quests of the fourth act, ending with Terror's End. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Act V: Siege on Harrogath to Eve of Destruction
chapters.summary: The six quests of the Lord of Destruction act, from the Siege on Harrogath to Eve of Destruction. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Nightmare, Hell, Hardcore and Every Class
chapters.summary: Finishing on Nightmare and Hell, with each class and in Hardcore, reaching level 99, every waypoint and every act quest.

chapters.title: Items, the Horadric Cube and Runes
chapters.summary: Gold, gems, sockets, Horadric Cube recipes, runes and rune words, sets, uniques, gambling and famous items.

chapters.title: Combat and Mercenaries
chapters.summary: Kill counts, hiring each kind of mercenary and collecting player ears.

Wiki structure from StrategyWiki under CC BY-SA 4.0 (chapter order from its walkthrough contents; titles reworded, no text copied) — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Diablo_II
Fandom (diablo.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://diablo.fandom.com/wiki/Diablo_II:_Resurrected
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Route cc-by-sa: on StrategyWiki "Diablo II: Resurrected" redirects to "Diablo II", whose categories list 2000 and 2021 and Vicarious Visions, so it covers the remaster too. It is at completion stage 2, with about 97 written subpages under "Diablo II/": Acts I to IV and every quest page in them (Den of Evil to Terror's End, plus Secret Cow Level), along with classes, skills, enemies and item pages. Act V lives under "Diablo II: Lord of Destruction" (also completion stage 2), with written pages for Act V and its six quests; its "Pandemonium Event" page is listed in the contents but not written, and both Walkthrough index pages are very short. About 344,000 characters across the 36 written walkthrough pages. Chapters follow that contents order, one per act; titles are reworded from quest names and no text was copied. The only Diablo II: Resurrected app in the Steam app list is 2536520, "Diablo II: Resurrected – Infernal Edition", which is the edition on sale; its schema calls the app "Dreadpine" (an internal codename). None of its 43 achievements is hidden. StrategyWiki lists the Assassin and Druid under Lord of Destruction, and the Steam list has Hell achievements for both, so the expansion is part of this game. diablo.fandom.com answers the API under "Diablo II: Resurrected", with about 57 linked pages, mostly series titles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG has no playtime yet.
